name: tech.geooptimizer/geo-audit
title: GEO Optimizer — AI Search & Robots.txt Audit
description: Live GEO readiness audit: check JSON-LD schemas, page speed, and AI crawler robots.txt access.

tools.name: audit_url_geo
tools.description: Run a live Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) audit on any URL: checks HTTPS, response time, JSON-LD schemas, headings, and AI crawler robots.txt permissions (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended). Returns an overall GEO readiness score (0-100) and actionable fix links.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Inspect a domain robots.txt policy for major AI search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot) and report whether each bot is allowed or blocked.
